Mr and Mrs Bishwash are going to a wedding party. Complete their conversation, using the words below in first conditional.

Mrs Bishwash: If we don’t hurry, (1) ......................................................................................... to the party on time.

Mr Bishwash: Hmmm, (2) ........................................................, if (3) ........................................................ a bit late.

Mrs Bishwash: I’m being panicked. What (4) ....................................................... if (5) ........................ there?

Mr Bishwash: I’m sure they (6) .................................... for ten fifteen minutes if (7) ....................................... there.

Mrs Bishwash: But it’s embarrassing! We are the host. It (8) ....................................... if some of them leave. The guests too (9) ....................................... with us if (10) ....................................... us there.

Mr Bishwash: Look, I’m already done!

(11) ....................................................... quickly if you keep calm.

Mrs Bishwash: Do you think Ms Perraira will come?

Mr Bishwash: She will come if (12) ................................................................................................. time.

Mrs Bishwash: And what about her daughter?

Mr Bishwash: She doesn’t like party. But (13) ....................................................... if you insist.

Mrs Bishwash: Are you ready now?

Mr Bishwash: Yes. And hope if (14) .............................................................................. bad traffic, we will reach the party house in time.
